title: ShadouCMDB webhook envelope, version 1
description: The JSON body of every webhook request ShadouCMDB sends. Fields are only ever added within a version; receivers must ignore fields they do not know. Verify X-ShadouCMDB-Signature before trusting the body, and deduplicate on `id` (X-ShadouCMDB-Delivery): delivery is at least once.

id.description: The delivery id; the same on every retry of this delivery (also sent as X-ShadouCMDB-Delivery and Idempotency-Key).

event.description: What happened: `workflow.` and the action's trigger, or `ping` for an endpoint test.

sequence.description: The workflow event's id: increases with every event of the server, so a receiver can order events (deliveries may arrive out of order after retries). Null for a ping.

url.description: Where the instance opens in the web UI (PUBLIC_URL); null when the server has no PUBLIC_URL.

versionNo.description: The workflow version the instance is on after the event.

transition.description: The transition applied or requested; null for a cancel or force.

state.description: The instance's state after the event.

approval.description: For the approval triggers: the request.

ci.description: The CI, read when the request is sent. Null when the CI no longer exists.

deleted.description: Present and true when the CI was deleted since the event; it then has no attributes.

attributes.description: Only the fields the action lists in includeAttributes (none by default), by key. A reference to another CI is an object {id, ident, label}.

actor.description: Who caused the event, by name only (no user id, no e-mail address).
